head: CalenCards plans your day as a deck of cards instead of a calendar grid
dek: CalenCards lays out your day as colorful cards you swipe away when done, aimed at people who find calendars cluttered. It was #97 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: You can add checklists, stamps and colors, swipe left to clear a card and shake to undo. The maker pitches it for pre-teens, teens and families. It costs $4.99 with no in-app purchases, by Lalalabs, and needs iOS 18.2.
means: If calendar apps feel like work, cards may be an easier way to see what's next.
todo: Find CalenCards in the App Store.
